title: Do I need an NOC or permit to renovate my apartment or villa in Dubai?
desc: When a renovation in Dubai needs a building or community NOC, what approvals depend on, and how NAVA handles the paperwork for you.
intro: Most renovations in Dubai need some form of approval before work starts, but the exact rules depend on your building, community and the type of work. Here is a general overview of how it usually works.
qa: Do I need an NOC to renovate my apartment in Dubai?

In most cases, yes. Most buildings ask owners to get a no-objection certificate from building or community management before any work beyond simple repairs. Requirements vary by building, so check with your management office first. NAVA can prepare and submit the application on your behalf as part of the project.
What renovation work usually needs approval in Dubai?

Work that changes walls, plumbing, electrical circuits, AC, flooring or the facade usually needs approval. Bigger structural changes, extensions or changes to a villa exterior may also need a permit from Dubai Municipality or the master developer. Painting and small repairs often need only a work permit for access, but rules differ by community.
Who gives the NOC for a villa renovation?

For villas, the NOC usually comes from the master developer or community management, and larger works may also need approval from Dubai Municipality or the relevant authority. Each community has its own process and documents. Your contractor should confirm which approvals apply before quoting a start date.
What documents are usually needed for a renovation NOC?

Typically the owner's title deed or ownership proof, Emirates ID or passport copy, a description or drawings of the planned work, and the contractor's trade licence and insurance details. Some buildings also ask for a refundable deposit. The exact list depends on the building or community, so always request their current checklist.
Can a tenant renovate without the landlord's permission?

No. A tenant needs written permission from the landlord before any renovation, and the building or community approval is normally applied for by or with the owner. Starting work without permission can lead to fines from management, a stop-work order or a dispute when you move out.
Can NAVA handle the NOC and permits for my renovation?

Yes. NAVA prepares the drawings and documents, submits them to building or community management, and coordinates with the authority where larger works need it. We include the approval steps in your timeline so work starts only once permission is in place. Approval times depend on the building and authority.

title: Bathroom renovation in Dubai: steps, timeline and what affects the cost
desc: The stages of a bathroom renovation in Dubai, how long it usually takes and the main factors that affect the cost of the project.
intro: A bathroom renovation involves more than new tiles. Plumbing, waterproofing and ventilation all need to be done properly, especially in the UAE where humidity and leaks to the flat below are common problems.
qa: What are the steps of a bathroom renovation?

A typical bathroom renovation follows these steps: site survey and design, building approval, strip-out of old tiles and fixtures, plumbing and electrical changes, waterproofing and a flood test, tiling, then installing the vanity, sanitaryware, shower glass and lighting. Each stage is checked before the next starts, so problems are not hidden behind new tiles.
How long does a bathroom renovation take in Dubai?

A standard bathroom renovation usually takes about two to four weeks once approval is in place. A simple refresh can be faster, while moving drains, changing the layout or waiting for imported tiles and fittings takes longer. Building working hours and approval times also affect the schedule.
What affects the cost of a bathroom renovation?

The main factors are bathroom size, whether the layout or drain positions change, the tiles and sanitaryware you choose, the extent of waterproofing and plumbing work, shower glass, and any concealed cisterns or niches. Access and building rules also play a part. NAVA gives a free written quote after a site visit.
Do I need to waterproof a bathroom during renovation?

Yes. Once old tiles are removed, the floor and the lower part of the shower walls should get a new waterproofing membrane and a flood test before retiling. In Dubai apartments, a failed membrane is a leading cause of leaks into the flat below, so skipping this step is a false saving.
Can I convert a bathtub to a walk-in shower?

Usually, yes. The bathtub is removed, the drain is repositioned or replaced, the floor is sloped and waterproofed, and a shower tray or tiled floor with glass screen is installed. The main check is whether the drain can be placed with enough fall. A site survey confirms this before work starts.
How do I stop mould in a bathroom in the UAE?

Make sure the bathroom has a working exhaust fan vented outside, use mould-resistant paint on the ceiling and walls, and choose quality grout and silicone. High humidity and AC temperature differences make bathrooms prone to condensation, so good ventilation is as important as good finishes.

title: Kitchen renovation planning guide for UAE homes
desc: How to plan a kitchen renovation in a UAE apartment or villa: layout, cabinets, worktops, ventilation, timeline and cost factors.
intro: A kitchen renovation goes smoothly when the layout, materials and services are decided before work begins. These answers cover the main decisions for kitchens in UAE homes.
qa: How do I plan a kitchen renovation?

Start with how you cook and store food, then measure the space and fix the layout before choosing finishes. Decide on appliances early, because cabinet sizes depend on them. Then plan plumbing, electrical points, lighting and ventilation, choose cabinets and worktops, and confirm building approval before any demolition.
What is the most practical kitchen layout for a UAE apartment?

For narrow apartment kitchens, a straight-line or galley layout usually works well. L-shaped and U-shaped layouts suit wider rooms, and an island needs clear walking space on all sides. Keep the sink, hob and fridge within easy reach of each other and allow worktop space beside the hob.
Which cabinet material suits the UAE climate?

Moisture-resistant board with good edge sealing, or marine plywood for sink cabinets, performs well in humid UAE kitchens. Finishes such as lacquer, acrylic or quality laminate are easy to clean. Use soft-close hardware rated for heavy use, and keep cabinets away from direct sun to prevent fading.
Quartz or granite worktop for a kitchen in Dubai?

Both are durable choices. Quartz is non-porous, consistent in pattern and needs no sealing. Granite is natural stone with unique patterns, handles heat well and needs occasional sealing. Quartz can discolour under strong direct sunlight, so for sunny or outdoor kitchens, granite is often the safer option.
How long does a kitchen renovation take?

A full kitchen renovation usually takes about three to six weeks after approval. Custom cabinets need time for production, and changes to plumbing, gas or electrical points add work on site. A refresh, such as new doors and worktops on existing cabinets, takes much less time.
What affects the cost of a kitchen renovation?

Cost depends on kitchen size, layout changes, cabinet material and finish, worktop type, appliances, plumbing and electrical work, lighting and the amount of demolition. Custom joinery and imported materials add to it. NAVA gives a free written quote after measuring the kitchen and agreeing the scope with you.

title: How to prepare for a move-out repaint and get your deposit back
desc: What landlords check at move-out in the UAE, how to prepare walls for a repaint and the small repairs that help protect your deposit.
intro: Many UAE tenancy contracts expect the property to be returned in the condition it was handed over, which often means a fresh coat of paint. Planning the repaint and small repairs early makes the handover much smoother.
qa: Do I have to repaint my apartment when I move out in Dubai?

It depends on your tenancy contract. Many contracts ask tenants to return the walls in their original colour and condition, which usually means a repaint, especially after several years or if you changed colours. Check your contract and handover report, and ask your landlord or agent what they expect.
How do I prepare walls for a move-out repaint?

Remove nails, screws, hooks and wall plugs, then fill the holes and sand them smooth. Clean marks and grease, treat any mould, and note cracks or stains that need primer. Move furniture away from the walls or into the middle of the room so painters can work quickly.
What do landlords check at move-out in the UAE?

Landlords and agents usually check wall condition and colour, holes from fixings, damaged doors and handles, broken tiles, AC filters and service records, light fittings, plumbing leaks, kitchen cabinets and general cleanliness. Comparing the property with your move-in photos or report helps show what is normal wear and tear.
How long before move-out should I book the painters?

Book about one to two weeks before your handover date. A typical apartment repaint takes one to three days depending on size and repairs, and the building may need a work permit first. Leaving a day or two between painting and handover gives time to fix anything the landlord points out.
What affects the cost of a move-out repaint?

The main factors are the number of rooms, ceiling height, wall condition, the number of holes and cracks to repair, whether colours need extra coats to return to white, and any doors or trims included. NAVA gives a free written quote and can combine painting with other move-out repairs.
Can NAVA handle all move-out repairs together?

Yes. Along with the repaint, NAVA can fix holes, replace broken tiles, repair doors and handles, service the AC, fix leaks and replace bulbs or fittings in one visit. Handling everything together saves coordinating several companies before your handover date.

title: Signs your villa roof needs waterproofing
desc: Warning signs that a villa roof in the UAE needs new waterproofing, why roofs fail in the heat and what the repair involves.
intro: UAE villa roofs face intense sun, high heat and sudden heavy rain. Waterproofing wears out over time, and spotting the early signs helps avoid damage to ceilings, paint and electrics below.
qa: How do I know if my roof needs waterproofing?

Common signs are ceiling stains or damp patches on the top floor, peeling paint near the roof, cracks or blisters in the roof surface, water pooling after rain, and a musty smell in upper rooms. If the existing membrane is old or patched in many places, it is worth having it inspected.
Why does roof waterproofing fail in the UAE?

Strong sun and high temperatures break down membranes and coatings over time, and the daily expansion and contraction of the roof slab opens cracks. Foot traffic from AC servicing, solar water heaters and satellite dishes also damages the surface. Blocked drains let water sit on the roof after rain.
Is a ceiling stain on the top floor always a roof leak?

Not always. Leaking AC drain lines, condensation from ducts and plumbing in the roof space can cause similar stains. A technician checks the roof surface, drains and equipment above the stain and uses a moisture meter to confirm the source before recommending waterproofing.
When should I waterproof a roof in the UAE?

The cooler months, roughly from October to April, are generally the most suitable time. Moderate temperatures help membranes and coatings bond and cure properly, and it is better to have the roof ready before the winter rains. Work in summer is possible but is usually scheduled for early mornings.
What does roof waterproofing involve?

The roof is cleaned and inspected, loose or failed material is removed, and cracks and joints are repaired. Drains, upstands and pipe penetrations are detailed, then a membrane or liquid coating is applied, often with a reflective top coat to reduce heat. A water test checks the result where possible.
What affects the cost of roof waterproofing?

The main factors are roof area, the condition of the existing layers, whether old membrane must be removed, the system chosen, the number of drains and penetrations, and access. Equipment such as AC units may need to be lifted. NAVA gives a free written quote after inspecting the roof.

title: Swimming pool maintenance in UAE summer: chillers, chemicals and cleaning
desc: How to keep a villa pool clean, balanced and swimmable in the UAE summer heat, including pool chillers, chemicals and dust.
intro: In UAE summer, pool water can get too warm to enjoy and algae grows quickly. Heat, sun and dust mean pools need closer attention from May to September.
qa: How often should a pool be cleaned in UAE summer?

In summer, most villa pools need cleaning at least twice a week, with skimmer baskets emptied more often during dusty or windy days. Water chemistry should be tested two to three times a week, because heat and sun use up chlorine quickly and algae can appear within days.
Do I need a pool chiller in Dubai?

If you want to swim comfortably in July and August, a chiller helps. Without one, outdoor pool water can become too warm to feel refreshing. A chiller is sized to the pool volume and connected to the filtration system. Shading the pool also helps reduce water temperature.
Why does my pool turn green in summer?

Green water is usually algae, caused by low chlorine, unbalanced pH, poor circulation or a dirty filter. High water temperatures and strong sun speed up algae growth and burn off chlorine. The fix is to brush the pool, shock-treat it, clean the filter and run the pump longer.
What chemicals does a pool need in the UAE?

A pool needs a sanitiser, usually chlorine or a salt system, plus pH control to keep levels balanced. Stabiliser helps protect chlorine from sunlight, and algaecide or shock treatment may be used when needed. Always follow product instructions and store chemicals in a cool, shaded place.
How long should the pool pump run in summer?

In summer, many pools need the pump running longer each day than in winter, often eight hours or more, so the full water volume is filtered several times. The right time depends on pool size, pump capacity and how much the pool is used. A technician can set a schedule.
How does dust affect a swimming pool?

Dust and sand storms add fine particles that cloud the water, clog filters and feed algae. After a dusty day, skim the surface, empty baskets, brush the walls and backwash or clean the filter. A pool cover helps when the pool is not in use.

title: Marble floor dull or scratched? Polishing vs replacing
desc: Why marble floors lose their shine in UAE homes, when polishing fixes it and when cracked or stained tiles need replacing instead.
intro: Marble floors are common in UAE villas and apartments, but sand, dust and daily use dull the surface over time. In most cases, professional polishing restores the floor without replacing a single tile.
qa: Why has my marble floor lost its shine?

Marble loses its shine mainly because fine sand and dust carried in on shoes act like sandpaper, wearing down the surface. Acidic cleaners, spills such as lemon juice or vinegar, and heavy furniture also etch and scratch it. The stone is usually fine underneath; only the top surface is worn.
Can a dull marble floor be polished back to shine?

Yes. Professional marble polishing grinds away the worn top layer with diamond pads in stages, then hones and polishes the surface to the gloss level you choose. Most scratches, etching and dullness can be removed this way. A sealer is often applied afterwards to help resist stains.
When should marble be replaced instead of polished?

Replacement makes sense when tiles are cracked, broken or loose, when stains have soaked deep into the stone, or when the floor has hollow spots from failed adhesive. In those cases, individual tiles can often be replaced and the whole floor polished afterwards so the repair blends in.
How long does marble polishing take?

A typical room can often be polished in one day, while a full villa ground floor may take several days depending on area and condition. Deep scratches and lippage between tiles take longer. The floor can usually be walked on soon after, with furniture moved back once it is dry.
How often should marble floors be polished in the UAE?

Many homes need polishing every one to three years, depending on foot traffic, pets and how much dust comes in. Using door mats, sweeping or dust-mopping often and cleaning with a pH-neutral stone cleaner helps the shine last longer between polishes.
What affects the cost of marble polishing?

The main factors are floor area, how worn or scratched the surface is, the finish you want, whether tiles need grinding to level them, crack or chip repairs, and sealing. Stairs and skirting add time. NAVA gives a free written quote after checking the floor.

title: Pergola: aluminium vs wood in the UAE climate
desc: Comparing aluminium and wood pergolas for UAE villas and terraces: heat, sun, humidity, maintenance and appearance.
intro: A pergola makes a garden or roof terrace usable for more of the year, but the UAE sun, heat and humidity are hard on outdoor materials. The choice between aluminium and wood mostly comes down to maintenance and look.
qa: Is aluminium or wood better for a pergola in the UAE?

Aluminium is usually more practical in the UAE because it does not rot, warp or attract termites, and a powder-coated finish needs little upkeep. Wood gives a warmer, natural look but needs regular sealing or staining to cope with strong sun, heat and humidity. Your choice depends on style and maintenance.
How long does a wooden pergola last in Dubai?

A wooden pergola can last many years in Dubai if it is built from suitable hardwood or treated timber and resealed regularly. Without maintenance, sun and humidity cause cracking, fading and warping. Coastal areas with salty, humid air need extra care for both the wood and its fixings.
Does an aluminium pergola get hot in the sun?

Aluminium beams can get warm in direct sun, but you rarely touch them, and the shade underneath is what matters. Lighter colours reflect more heat. Adding louvres, a solid roof or shade fabric gives better protection from the sun than an open slatted design.
What maintenance does a pergola need in the UAE?

Aluminium pergolas need washing to remove dust and occasional checks of screws and fixings. Wooden pergolas need cleaning, sanding and resealing or staining, usually every year or two, plus checks for cracks and termites. Fabric or louvred roofs also need cleaning after dust storms.
Do I need permission to build a pergola on my villa?

Often, yes. Many communities and master developers require approval for pergolas and other outdoor structures, and some have rules on size, height and colour. Check with your community management before ordering. NAVA can prepare drawings and help with the application.
What affects the cost of a pergola?

The main factors are size, material, design, roof type such as open slats, louvres or a solid roof, foundations, lighting and fans, and site access. Custom colours and motorised louvres add to it. NAVA gives a free written quote after visiting the site and agreeing the design.

title: Villa exterior painting in the UAE: when and how
desc: When to repaint a villa exterior in the UAE, the right season for the work, suitable paint systems and how to prepare the walls.
intro: Exterior walls in the UAE take a beating from sun, heat, humidity and dust. Choosing the right season, paint system and preparation makes the difference between a finish that lasts and one that fades quickly.
qa: How often should a villa exterior be painted in the UAE?

Many villa exteriors need repainting every three to five years, depending on sun exposure, colour, paint quality and how close the villa is to the sea. Walls facing south and west fade faster. Repaint sooner if you see chalking, peeling, cracks or stains.
What time of year should I paint my villa exterior in the UAE?

The cooler months, roughly from October to April, suit exterior painting. In summer, very hot walls make paint dry too fast, which can cause poor adhesion and lap marks. If summer work is needed, painters work early in the morning and avoid walls in direct sun.
What type of paint is used for UAE villa exteriors?

Exterior walls need a paint system made for hot, sunny climates: usually a suitable primer or sealer, then two coats of an exterior emulsion with good UV and dirt resistance. Elastomeric or textured coatings can help bridge fine cracks. Light colours reflect more heat and fade less visibly.
How do you prepare exterior walls before painting?

The walls are washed to remove dust and salt, loose and flaking paint is scraped off, and cracks are filled or repaired. Damp areas are checked and treated, then a primer or sealer is applied. Good preparation is the main factor in how long exterior paint lasts.
Do I need permission to change my villa's exterior colour?

Often, yes. Many communities and master developers control exterior colours and ask owners to use approved shades or get approval first. Repainting in the same colour may only need a work permit. Check with your community management before choosing a new colour.
What affects the cost of exterior painting?

The main factors are wall area and height, the condition of the existing paint, crack and damp repairs, the paint system chosen, scaffolding or access equipment, and boundary walls, gates or metalwork included. NAVA gives a free written quote after inspecting the villa.

title: How to choose an interior fit-out or renovation company in Dubai
desc: A practical checklist for choosing a renovation or fit-out company in Dubai: licence, written quote, warranty, team and references.
intro: Choosing the right contractor matters more than any material you pick. This checklist helps you compare renovation and fit-out companies in Dubai on the points that protect your home and budget.
qa: How do I choose a renovation company in Dubai?

Check that the company holds a valid trade licence for the work, gives a detailed written quote, offers a written warranty, uses its own trained team and can show references or completed projects. Compare at least two or three quotes on the same scope rather than on price alone.
How do I check if a contractor is licensed in Dubai?

Ask for a copy of the company's trade licence and check that the listed activities match your work, such as fit-out, maintenance or specific trades. You can also confirm the licence through official Dubai government channels. Building management usually asks for the licence when you apply for approval.
What should a renovation quote include?

A good quote lists each area and task, the materials and brands, quantities, what is excluded, the timeline, payment stages and warranty terms. Vague one-line quotes make it hard to compare companies and often lead to extra charges later. Ask for anything unclear to be written down before you sign.
Why does an in-house team matter for renovation?

A company with its own team has direct control over quality, scheduling and supervision. When work is passed to several subcontractors, coordination is harder and responsibility for problems can be unclear. Ask who will actually do the work and who supervises the site day to day.
What warranty should a renovation company give?

Ask for a written warranty that states what is covered, such as workmanship, waterproofing or installed fittings, and for how long. Manufacturer warranties on products are separate. Make sure you know how to report a problem and how quickly the company will respond.
What questions should I ask before hiring a contractor?

Ask how long they have worked in the UAE, whether they handle building approvals, who supervises the work, how payments are staged, how changes are priced, and if you can speak to previous clients. NAVA is happy to answer these questions and provides a free written quote.
